blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A trial chamber of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has allowed the prosecution to add more killing incidents, except for one involving a high-value target, to the charges against former President Rodrigo Duterte for crimes against humanity. The judges of Trial Chamber (TC) III, in a decision on Oct. 9, partially granted the request by the prosecution to include eight more incidents in the charges, arguing that they fell within the scope of the charges of three counts of murder confirmed at the pretrial stage.
